scope: Upstream cache unit semantics and an unchanged AST-isolated step method with synthetic outputs; not model inference or an environment experiment
cache_import: Direct file import of src/models/kv_caching.py; no models package import
positive_control: Deliberately shared reference changes its owner; validates detector sensitivity only, not an upstream aliasing flaw

step_probe.body: Unmodified upstream AST; original torch.no_grad decorator retained
step_probe.substitutions: Synthetic parameter-free tensor producer, action readout and token-copy decoder; real upstream cache implementation

interpretation: The checked branch-copy operations isolate root/sibling valid prefixes and sizes. Explicit-cache step updates do not update the member cache; current MCTS call-site therefore saves a stale child prefix. No model predictions, task utility, malicious interface or security harm were tested.
limitations: Small synthetic cache tensors; no checkpoint, neural inference, Atari environment, full Agent/MCTS execution or concurrency test.
Only valid prefixes and sequence sizes are compared; unused torch.empty capacity is not meaningful data.
The stale-child observation is an implementation/call-site correctness issue, not rejected-branch contamination of real history.
Observation ownership is checked for the source's view-then-cat-rebinding operations; arbitrary external in-place edits are not an identified native interface.
Complete Agent execution across two planning calls, RNG behavior and shared neural-model buffers were not tested; these unit results do not establish whole-system isolation.

post_execution_changes.change: Added optional --out CLI with unchanged default and no-overwrite behavior after the single completed run; no assertion or scientific operation changed. Added explicit untested whole-Agent/RNG/shared-buffer scope.
